messages:
Alex K: Rolled the hybrid prefix+LRU cache + small-batch policy to canary (10% traffic) at 1780123456.
Alex K: Early numbers look solid: p95 gen latency down ~17% on chat routes, median tokens/s cost down ~21% vs baseline. p99 unchanged.
Sasha R: Nice! Any impact on cold-starts or KV cache miss tails?
Alex K: Cold-starts slightly better due to LRU prefetch heuristics. Miss tail p99 improved ~5ms. Full metrics in the dashboard link below.
deploy-bot: Deploy successful: canary=10% -> commit abcdef1 -> runtime/helix-cache v2.3.4
Pranav: Canary config we used:
```
batching:
  small_batch_threshold: 8
  dynamic_window: true
kvcache:
  mode: hybrid
  lru_prefetch: 0.2
```
Pranav: If we flip `lru_prefetch` to 0.35 we can shave another ~3% p95 but increases memory by ~6%.
Maria D: What's the plan for rollout windows and rollback criteria? Also any regression on long-seq QA tests?
observability-bot: Canary dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/r/helix-cache-canary
observability-bot: Metrics snapshot (canary vs baseline): p50 -12%, p95 -17%, p99 -2%, token-cost -21%, mem +5.8%
Sasha R: QA long-seq showed no degenerate logits; ran 3k prompts overnight.
Alex K: Plan: increase canary to 50% tomorrow 10:00 UTC if no alerts by 08:00. Rollback if p95 worsens >3% or token-cost increases >5%.
Maria D: I'll schedule a short post-canary sync 11:00 UTC to capture notes and follow-ups. TY team :tada:
Alex K: Great work all, thanks :rocket:
